question: Who wins the Ohio Senate special election in 2026
quote: I think it's Brown as well.
turn_text: I think it's Brown as well. Just going with the polling on this one. And also going back to my principle that if you don't have a kind of your own political persona that's very, very notable, your own political identity, you're going to be in trouble. And Husted, maybe Trump's kind of given him one. You know, as I used to say about Marilyn Monroe, her figure, you know, she has a great future behind her. And Trump's kind of tried to do that to Husted, but that's not a voting issue. So I'm with Brown. I'm going to go with Brown as well. Also, MBD is D plus three. The rest of us are D plus two. And that takes us to the epic state of Texas, Jim Garrity.
host_quote: Jim Garrity, to Ohio. We have Republican Senator John Husted trying to hold on against former Democratic Senator Sherrod Brown.
resolution_criteria: The candidate who wins the 2026 Ohio US Senate special general election. Decided by the Associated Press's call. If AP has not called it within 60 days of election day, the certified official result decides. Resolves when the race is called.
outcome_source_title: AP: Sherrod Brown flips Senate seat in Ohio for Democrats by ousting Sen. Jon Husted
